content:
ana: Opening a small docs PR to add a short 'bastion vs direct HSM' note to the private install guide. Also including a minimal nftables example for air-gapped sites and a tiny troubleshooting blurb about iptables-nft compatibility.

liam: Quick skim: agree with adding bastion guidance. Suggest we explicitly call out the HSM admin port (6010) as optional when using a bastion and add an example SSH tunnel command.

tess: Good idea. Example SSH tunnel snippet looks fine but swap the fake key path for a placeholder: ~/.ssh/id_redwood. Also add a reminder to rotate bastion keys per security policy.

infra-ops: Confirmed: bastion-first approach is recommended for sensitive HSM deployments. We prefer firewall rules scoped to the mgmt CIDR rather than per-node IPs. Will add vendor port exceptions as appendix entries separately.

ana: Drafted nftables snippet for the air-gapped page: 

```
# allow mgmt subnet -> kms (HTTPS)
nft add table inet redwood
nft add chain inet redwood forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; }
# accept new+established from mgmt subnet
nft add rule inet redwood forward ip saddr 10.20.0.0/24 tcp dport 443 ct state new,established accept
# allow established related traffic back
nft add rule inet redwood forward ct state established,related accept
```

liam: Looks good. Add a one-line caution: 'run these as a privileged user and test in a non-prod environment first.'

tess: Also added a one-liner about iptables compatibility: 'On some OS images the iptables-legacy frontend may translate rules; see distro notes.'

docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck: no broken links detected. Markdown lint: one heading-level warning.

ana: Thanks all. I'll push the tiny fixes (placeholder key path, SSH tunnel example, caution line) and merge once CI green. Will ping #support after merge so oncall knows about the bastion guidance addition.

infra-ops: +1

liam: +1

ana: Merged and posted blurb to #support. Follow-up: will create an appendix PR for vendor-specific port tables if needed.
